changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs v0.2.0 backfill (2/2): move the staged log text into job_logs, one row per job (per-line timestamps were never preserved by the old single-column design, so a historical job's full log becomes a single job_logs row), then drop the staging column. Runs after the lib-jobs library changelog has created job_logs and dropped jobs.log -- included separately in changelog-master.json rather than swept up by includeAll, since it must run after that library include, not before it like every other app-owned changeset.

sql.sql: INSERT INTO job_logs (job_id, message, created_at) SELECT id, log_backfill, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) FROM jobs WHERE log_backfill IS NOT NULL AND log_backfill <> ''
